prompt.project_info: A soft, sunlit indoor portrait with creamy whites, a window-seat composition, and quiet early-morning calm.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with voluminous blonde waves, curtain bangs, a direct serene gaze, and naturally textured skin. She wears a lightweight white button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, white cotton shorts, and simple white ankle socks.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium vertical portrait of the subject seated on a white cushioned window seat with knees comfortably tucked to one side. A white painted wooden window frame, wrought-iron balcony rail, and blurred green foliage form the background; no text or logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffused natural morning light through the window at approximately 5000K, soft warm highlights, gentle shadows, visible fabric creases, subtle film grain, and restrained creamy white/beige tones.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad X2D with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, vertical 3:4 crop, raw photographic rendering, shallow depth of field, realistic optics, fine grain, and gentle natural vignetting.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic raw-style portrait of an adult woman with voluminous soft blonde waves and curtain bangs, seated on a white cushioned window seat with knees comfortably tucked to one side. She wears a lightweight white button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, white cotton shorts, and simple white ankle socks. Airy sun-drenched interior with a white wooden window frame, blurred greenery, and a wrought-iron balcony railing outside, direct serene gaze, natural skin texture, diffused morning light, muted creamy whites and soft beige, eye-level medium vertical portrait, no text or branding.
